children: (“AIFU” or the “Company”), a leading AI-driven independent financial services platform in China, today announced that it has entered into a transaction agreement (the “Transaction Agreement”) with Sunrise Capital Partners Ltd., Ballet Holding Ltd., Timber Management Limited, and Modern Holding Ltd. (collectively, the “Sellers”) to acquire 100% of the equity interests in Waltz Investment Holding Ltd. (the “Target Company”). The Target Company indirectly holds 99% of the equity interests in Shenzhen Waltz New Material Applied Technology Co., Ltd. (“Shenzhen Waltz”) (the “Transaction”). The Transaction values the Target Company at approximately US$44.61 million, equivalent to approximately RMB300 million.

Pursuant to the Transaction Agreement, the total consideration for the Transaction will comprise: (i) the issuance of 11,203,443 Class A ordinary shares of AIFU (the “Consideration Shares”) at an issue price of US$3.00 per share, representing aggregate share consideration of approximately US$33.61 million; and (ii) US$11 million in cash.

The transaction is expected to close on or before the end of November 2026, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions set forth in the Transaction Agreement. Upon completion of the transaction, the Sellers are expected to hold, in the aggregate, approximately 15.48% of AIFU's total issued and outstanding shares, representing approximately 1.03% of the Company's total voting power. The Consideration Shares will be subject to a lock-up period of 60 months, subject to certain customary exceptions.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, Shenzhen Waltz is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the coating, processing, and application of functional optical films. Leveraging its expertise in functional film coating, film lamination, and application-specific forming and fitting, the Company provides customized functional film products and related technical services to customers in new energy vehicle, smart cockpits, and consumer electronics industries. Shenzhen Waltz has been recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise by the Chinese government and as a “Specialized, Refined, Distinctive, and Innovative” Enterprise by the Shenzhen Municipal government. The company holds 17 patents and serves approximately 280 customers.

Mingxiu Luan, Chief Executive Officer of AIFU, commented, “Shenzhen Waltz has established deep technical expertise, a mature product portfolio, and a broad customer base in the functional optical films industry. This acquisition will further expand AIFU's presence in the high-tech sector and create new growth opportunities for the Company. Looking ahead, we intend to explore opportunities to leverage AIFU's technologies and resources in artificial intelligence and digitalization to support Shenzhen Waltz in advancing its research and development capabilities and operational efficiency, driving its long-term business growth, and creating sustainable value for our shareholders.”
